ezra.9.p1.b1.text: After these things had been accomplished, the leaders approached me and said,

ezra.9.p1.b2.text: “The people of Israel, including the priests and Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the surrounding peoples whose abominations are like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, …

ezra.9.p1.b3.text: Indeed, the Israelites have taken some of their daughters as wives for themselves and their sons, … And the leaders and officials have taken the lead in this unfaithfulness!”

ezra.9.p2.b1.text: When I heard this report, I tore my tunic and cloak,

ezra.9.p2.b2.text: pulled out some hair from my head and beard, and sat down in horror.

ezra.9.p2.b3.text: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered around me because of the unfaithfulness of the exiles, while I sat there in horror until the evening offering.

ezra.9.p3.b1.text: At the evening offering, I got up from my humiliation with my tunic and cloak torn, and I fell on my knees, spread out my hands to the LORD my God,

ezra.9.p3.b2.text: “O my God, I am ashamed and embarrassed to lift up my face to You, my God, because our iniquities are higher than our heads, and our guilt has reached the heavens.

ezra.9.p3.b3.text: Because of our iniquities, we and our kings and priests have been delivered into the hands of the kings of the earth …

ezra.9.p3.b4.text: But now, for a brief moment, grace has come from the LORD our God … to give us a stake in His holy place.

ezra.9.p4.b1.text: And now, our God, what can we say after this? For we have forsaken the commandments

ezra.9.p4.b2.text: … do not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters for your sons. …

ezra.9.p4.b3.text: shall we again break Your commandments and intermarry with the peoples who commit these abominations?

ezra.9.p4.b4.text: O LORD, God of Israel, You are righteous! For we remain this day as a remnant. Here we are before You in our guilt, though because of it no one can stand before You.”
